newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P ADEF puts AXA notes on creditwatch.
newsitem.headline: S&P ADEF puts AXA notes on creditwatch.

text.p: Standard & Poor ADEF, the rating agency, said on Thursday it had put notes issued by AXA and UAP on creditwatch as a result of the planned merger between the two French insurers announced on Tuesday.
It said the the creditwatch had negative implications for the AXA paper and positive implications for UAP notes.

S&P and ADEF said in a statement notes issued by AXA's U.S. subsidiary Equitable, its Australian unit National Mutual Life Association and the investment bank Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette Inc. had also been placed on creditwatch with negative implications.
The statement said the only subsidiaries of the two groups not on creditwatch were AXA Re Finance SA and Alliance Capital Management L.P.
The rating agency affirmed its short-term A1 counterparty rating for AXA Re Finance and its long-term A counterparty rating for Alliance Capital Management.
S&P said the creditwatch on AXA's notes carried a negative implication to "reflect the risks of a weakening of the financial position of the AXA group because of the merger."
